# secrets

```go
import "github.com/brpaz/sops-tui/internal/secrets"
```

Package secrets discovers YAML/JSON files under a directory tree and determines whether each one is SOPS\-encrypted.

<a name="Edit"></a>
## func Edit

```go
func Edit(path string) error
```

Edit runs \`sops \<path\>\` as a foreground subprocess with inherited stdio: sops decrypts to a temp file, launches $EDITOR on it, and re\-encrypts on save. The caller is responsible for suspending its own terminal UI before calling Edit.

<a name="EditCommand"></a>
## func EditCommand

```go
func EditCommand(path string) *exec.Cmd
```

EditCommand returns the unstarted \`sops \<path\>\` command, with stdio left unset, for a caller that manages its own terminal handoff \(e.g. a BubbleTea program suspending itself via tea.ExecProcess\).

<a name="Encrypt"></a>
## func Encrypt

```go
func Encrypt(path string) error
```

Encrypt encrypts the file at path in place, using the nearest .sops.yaml's creation rules to select keys.

<a name="View"></a>
## func View

```go
func View(path string) (string, error)
```

View returns the decrypted content of the file at path. The file on disk is left unchanged.

<a name="FileEntry"></a>
## type FileEntry

FileEntry describes one discovered file and its encryption status.

```go
type FileEntry struct {
    // Path is the file's path relative to the scan root.
    Path string
    // Status is the file's SOPS encryption status.
    Status Status
    // Err is set when Status is StatusUnknown because the file could not
    // be parsed.
    Err error
}
```

<a name="List"></a>
### func List

```go
func List(root string) ([]FileEntry, error)
```

List recursively scans root for .yaml/.yml/.json files and reports each file's SOPS encryption status. When root is inside a git work tree, gitignored paths \(e.g. vendor/, node\_modules/, build caches\) are excluded the same way \`git status\` would exclude them; otherwise it falls back to skipping .git, node\_modules, and vendor directories at any depth.

<a name="Status"></a>
## type Status

Status is the SOPS encryption status of a scanned file.

```go
type Status int
```

<a name="StatusUnknown"></a>

```go
const (
    // StatusUnknown means the file's status could not be determined,
    // typically because it failed to parse.
    StatusUnknown Status = iota
    StatusEncrypted
    StatusPlaintext
)
```
